verdict.rationale: Kong ships official CLIs. decK is documented as a command-line tool for automating the API lifecycle (APIOps), and kongctl has its own docs page, including an AI Gateway conversion extension. The evidence is mostly brief headings, though, and does not show the CLIs serving AI-native or agent workflows. missing for 10: documentation of agent-friendly CLI behavior (machine-readable output, non-interactive or scriptable use by AI agents), in-depth kongctl feature docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
